bottleneck.description: Sole commercial supplier of EUV mask blank inspection (MBI) and actinic patterned mask inspection (APMI) tools. EUV reticle manufacturing at advanced nodes cannot be quality-controlled without Lasertec equipment.

dependency.key_customers: TSMC, Samsung Foundry, Intel Foundry, mask shops (Toppan, DNP, Hoya, Photronics)
dependency.key_suppliers: Carl Zeiss SMT (EUV optics), Japanese subsystem supply chain

editorial.notes: KLA and Applied Materials do not offer competing EUV-actinic mask inspection. ASML and the foundry/IDM ecosystem publicly acknowledge Lasertec's monopoly in EUV mask inspection. DUV-based mask inspection cannot detect printable defect modes that emerge under EUV exposure at sub-7nm geometries, so the bottleneck deepens as nodes shrink. Mirrors ASML's EUV-scanner monopoly one tier upstream in the mask production chain.
